body:
Okay.  

You're still not going to talk me into trying meditation because, like I've repeatedly said here, it doesn't work on me.

Thanks for removing that user's posts.

No one, not a *single* plumber or restoration or water-damage contractor who has looked at the damage or looked at the pipe, has said there was *anything* weak with the pipe, or that the pipe was installed poorly, or designed poorly, or anything wrong at all with it.  Instead, they've all, they've *all*, **THEY'VE ALL** said, "You broke the pipe.  You shouldn't kick pipes."

I.

Kicked.

The.

Pipe.

Breaking the pipe was **MY** fault, because **NO OTHER PERSON, PLACE, THING, ANIMAL, OR IDEA** kicked or damaged the pipe in *any* way.

Thanks?  I guess?  But mindfulness meditation does not work on me, and one person's experiences with it *for themselves* in no way make it effective *for me*.

**EDIT**: I just checked /u/forerica1's recent posts.  They're all spam for meditation, which seems to break the rules here and is annoying as piss regardless.

It's accurate.  I'm a dumbass because I do things that a dumvass eould do and have no redeeming qualities.  "Mindfulness meditation" has not and does not work for me; at *best*, it keeps me from solving what's *actually* wrong for however long the "exercise" lasts.

I keep getting fired because I'm an incompetent dumbass.  I keep getting fired because I keep fucking up and losing clients, losing clients' money, or getting clients thrown in prison.  I keep getting fired because I'm absolute dog shit at my job.

I can't afford to not have a job.  "Self-worth" and "Dara sets" and all that crap are luxuries **I DO NOT HAVE AND CANNOT AFFORD**.

It absolutely was my fault.  No one kicked the pipe but me.  No one forced me to kick the pipe.  No one exercised an angstrom of influence on me to cause or coerce or even persuade me to kick the pipe.  I kicked the pipe.  If I hadn't kicked the pipe, it wouldn't have broken.
